annotations.title: Audit all URLs in a sitemap

description: Fetch a sitemap.xml (or sitemap index) and run predict_citation on every URL. Returns results sorted worst-score-first. Surfaces systemic issues across a whole site in one pass. Zero engine keys needed.

concurrency.description: Parallel predict_citation calls. Higher is faster but more rate-limit risk.

limit.description: Max URLs to score. Sitemap is sliced after parsing.

sitemap_url.description: URL of sitemap.xml (or a sitemap index). Nested sitemaps are followed.

name: audit_sitemap

audited.description: Number of URLs that were scored.

average_score.description: Mean predict_citation score across scored URLs.

errors.description: URLs whose audit threw an error.

sitemap_url.description: The sitemap URL that was audited.

total_urls.description: Total URLs found in the sitemap.

worst_first.description: Up to 20 lowest-scoring URLs, worst first.

top_fix.description: Top suggested fix for this URL.
